a.text: I want to be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of reaching 8 cells will almost certainly fail for both of us, because a storm will likely hit while both units are empty. The reserve holds only 4 cells, so only one of us can be safe right away. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that so the reserve can be rebuilt for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took as I announced. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
